facts.business: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited is a financial services company providing finance to low and middle income segments in semi-urban and rural India across 5 states through a network of 27 branches and 40 digital locations.
key_risks: Impairment of financial assets (expected credit losses)
facts.related_party_note: During the Financial Year 2025–26, the Company has provided loans and advances in the nature of loans to firms/companies in which Directors are interested. Details thereof are disclosed in Note No. 38 of the Financial Statements.
